author: China Insights
description:
What do the newly declassified intelligence files actually reveal about alleged Chinese efforts to influence the 2020 U.S. presidential election?

In this episode, we examine newly released documents, internal intelligence emails, and the story of Christopher Porter, a senior U.S. intelligence official who warned that China was collecting voter data and developing capabilities that could be used to influence the election. Porter later argued that key intelligence was minimized, delayed, or excluded from official assessments.

We also explore allegations involving large-scale voter registration data collection, cyber operations, reports of counterfeit identification documents, disputed election-related investigations, and the internal debate within the U.S. intelligence community over how these findings should be presented.

title: Newly Declassified Files Reveal Alleged Chinese Election Influence—and an Intelligence Cover-Up
